“Carve your own little slice of Appalachia to call home in Fallout 76's latest update! Available now and free for all players, this update includes Relaxed Build Rules for Adventure Mode, a reworked user interface for the Workshop and more.”— fallout.bethesda.net (archived)

***C.A.M.P. Revamp*** is the twenty-fourth major update for *Fallout 76*. It was released on September 2, 2025. It was preceded by *Gone Fission* and was followed by *Burning Springs*.

The update includes an overhaul of the C.A.M.P. building mechanic, as well as the twenty-second season: *Appalachian Modern Living*.

## Features[]

- Season 22: *Appalachian Modern Living*
- An overhaul to the C.A.M.P. system, including:
 - New UI for the C.A.M.P. system.
 - New categorization for various buildable objects.
 - Loosened restrictions on placement, including free placement anywhere in a build zone.
 - Toggles for snapping and intersecting.
 - Other quality of life improvements.
- Event: Mischief Night returns as a seasonal public event in a reworked format, beginning in October.
- Item locking - Never accidentally scrap or drop gear again.
- Caravan event restructuring; the event will automatically complete if the brahmin is kept alive by the 7 minute mark, and all players receive the same number of Supplies regardless of who initiated the event.
- Combat changes including V.A.T.S. and manual aiming improvements, increased weapon ranges, perk changes, significant melee and bow weapon changes, and other balance updates.
- Updates to the Spooky Scorched community event as of October 2025.
